lines: Sit a moment. What I'm asking is not small: {item}, taken from {boss} in the {structure}. It is {danger}, and I've lit more candles for the people I sent there than I care to count.
{item}. From {boss}, deep in the {structure}. I won't dress it up: it is {danger}, and it has buried better fighters than either of us.
{boss} holds {item} in the {structure}. It's {danger}. Think carefully before you agree; I need you alive more than I need it today.
I've a dangerous request: {item} from {boss}, in the {structure}. It's {danger}. Go prepared, and leave yourself a way out.
The {structure} holds {item}, and {boss} stands between us and it. It's {danger}. I won't blame you for refusing.
